note: _habebis locum extra castra, ad quem egrediaris ad requisita naturae_ – you shall have a place outside the camp to which you may go “for the necessities of nature.” The expression _ad requisita naturae_, added by Jerome for clarification, has no basis in the Hebrew text; it seems to echo Sallustius as quoted in Qunitilian: _Institutio oratoria_ VIII, 6,59. – Neil Adkin: Biblia Pagana: Classical Echoes in the Vulgate. _Augustinianum_ 40 (2000) 77–87, at pp. 82–87. ▲
